notes.title: Sequel & iOS
notes.notes:
I am happy to confirm that we have now begun work on a sequel within the Highschool Romance franchise, it will be a new story but with similar twists, created by the same team as the original. (Artist, writer & coder).

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
We have just released version 1.11 update for Highschool Romance, which corrects issues that have been brought up to do with the odd character dialogue having the incorrect names in places.

It fixes a number of small bugs that only a tiny tiny minority would have encountered and generally polishes all aspects of the game.

This update also sees the GUI given an extra polish, with version number being shown as well as a help file link. In addition we have added navigation arrows and simply put made everything nicer.

This update also corrects the CG gallery error that has been noted a few times, where the gallery is unlocked from the start, this update should fix that for all new players so they can unlock the gallery normally. It may however not fix it for existing players, or it may remove all currently unlocked images, requiring a replay. Sorry to those it affects.

Last but not least we did a few more revisions within the game itself, edited some more of the dialogue and made some adjustments to the story in places, this again could on a very small minority cause an error to occur when you load a save game. If this occurs try an earlier save point and carry on. We have tried to mitigate this as much as possible.

We managed to include the extra 'maid' scene we mentioned, though it is one of the harder scenes to unlock in the game, if any of them are hard, this would be the hardest.

We hope you all enjoy the game in T-minus 22 hours and counting...


P.s. we will also be looking to post updates over the coming few days with some adjustments and any bug fixes that have been missed from our relatively short beta test.

notes.title: Slight Delay
notes.notes:
Due to some unforseen circumstances Highschool Romance release has been delayed until Wednesday 18th November.

Though this change was unexpected we will be using the time to add a larger musical score and more effects to the game. As well as a brand new ecchi 'maid' scene.

Thank you.
